partner_source.result_applied: rank-one sign-routed physical-core stability plus dense-tail physical-three-coordinate density cap

new_results.statement: For invertible B and update U Theta U^T, after diagonalizing the active Theta into positive/negative spectral subspaces, if K=U^T B^{-1}U satisfies K_{++} >= kappa I and K_{--} <= -kappa I, then sigma_min(B+U Theta U^T) >= [||B^{-1}||+||B^{-1}U||^2/kappa]^{-1}, independently of all nonzero eigenvalue magnitudes of Theta. The mixed K_{+-} block is unrestricted.
On an original-coordinate physical triple, adding an arbitrary-rank symmetric tail T with ||T||<=delta below the Krein-Woodbury gap gives ||p_Q||_infinity <= 6 sqrt(pi)/(gamma-delta).

If each sign orthant of finitely many fixed spectral directions has a physical triple whose inverse-leverage form has matching positive/negative definiteness, then all update magnitudes in all covered orthants are free; a finite family of cores routes arbitrary sign changes.

An explicit 24-dimensional eight-triple baseline with three global orthonormal update eigenvectors absorbs three simultaneous arbitrary real update eigenvalues; after any dense tail of norm delta<2, ||p_Q||_infinity <= 6 sqrt(pi)/(2-delta).

proof_key_identity: For M=Theta^{-1}+K=J D^{-1}+K, x^T J M x = x^T D^{-1}x + x_+^T K_{++}x_+ - x_-^T K_{--}x_- because the K_{+-} cross terms cancel exactly; hence sigma_min(M)>=kappa and Woodbury gives the uniform inverse bound.
unresolved_implication: Bare s_3(A)>=1 still does not force a sign-compatible or finite-orthant-complete physical core family; must derive such a core or route into an existing aggregate-before-inversion ridge, grouped-bank, hub, pair-log, or cross-volume branch.
next_step: Study the high inverse-leverage mixed-sign failure of the orthant condition: if K_{++} is not positive or K_{--} not negative on every candidate core, convert the resulting concentrated sign-conflicting physical footprint into a paid local pair/triple or aggregate bank certificate.
